newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fresenius buys U.S. laboratory service group.
newsitem.headline: Fresenius buys U.S. laboratory service group.

text.p: German medical services group Fresenius Medical Care AG said on Thursday its North American unit has bought Spectra Laboratories, a U.S. provider of end-stage renal disease laboratory services.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Spectra, which is based in Fremont, California, had 1996 sales of more than $45 million, Fresenius said in a statement.

Fresenius said it would have four U.S. laboratories after the deal with Spectra, which provides clinical laboratory testing services to more than 30,000 patients, and create a new sales and marketing unit called Spectra Renal Management.
Fresenius has an existing laboratory business, LifeChem, that offers services to about 61,000 patients.
Fresenius Medical Care was created in September 1996 when German medical products group Fresenius AG merged its dialysis business with National Medical Care, a unit of U.S. group W.R. Grace.
